displayTitle: T0-B1: The Droid Who Became a Jedi
synopsis: Visions: T0-B1 is a young readers book adapting the Star Wars: Visions short film "T0-B1." Meet a new kind of Jedi in this Little Golden Book about Star Wars: Visions' young hero, T0-B1. This Little Golden Book is based on the T0-B1 entry of Star Wars: Visions, a collection of short films created by Japanese anime studios, streaming exclusively on Disney+. In the animated short, a young droid named T0-B1 explores a desert planet, discovers the force and fulfills his dream of becoming a Jedi. Featuring stunning anime-inspired illustrations, this book introduces fans of all ages to a new worlds and characters in the Star Wars saga, in the classic, reliable Little Golden Book format.
title: T0-B1: The Droid Who Became a Jedi
